name: issue-pr-cron
description: Claude Code assets published by the rainlanguage issue→PR pipeline.

plugins.name: human-fsm
plugins.description: Slash commands for the human's side of the issue→PR pipeline FSM: read the next ai:ready PR and check the vetter's verdict against the diff and the issue it closes, read the next ai:close-candidate flag and check the producer's reason against the issue and the code it claims about, then rule on a close-candidate, reject, raise a design question, or keep an issue open. Every input comes from pr-review-report; none writes GitHub state itself.
